name: PMMA
toxicity: can be considered extremely toxic when compared to other substances such as Methamphetamine or MDMA
Ingestion of PMMA has been associated with severe tachycardia (abnormally high heart rate), seizures, hyperthermia, and death
summary: PMMA is a empathogen substance belonging to the Amphetamine, Substituted amphetamines chemical class.
advisory: Ingestion of PMMA has been associated with severe tachycardia (abnormally high heart rate), seizures, hyperthermia, and death.

pharmacology.text: PMMA is a monoamine releasing agent (MRA). The drug's EC50 values for induction of monoamine release in rat brain synaptosomes have been reported for the individual enantiomers of PMMA.
pharmacology.kind: Psychoactive drug; Serotonin–norepinephrine releasing agent; Monoamine oxidase inhibitor

uses.text: PMMA has been found in tablets and capsules of the MDMA sold as "ecstasy". A number of deaths have been attributed to tablets sold as ecstasy that contained other substances, such as PMMA's structural analog, PMA.

summaryZh: 對甲氧基甲基安非他命，簡稱PMMA，俗稱「強力搖頭丸」，黑話「死神」。本化合物是以色列開發出的一種狡詐家藥物，具有迷幻效果的禁藥，被多國家列為管制藥品。

sideEffects.en: PMMA has caused many deaths, often when sold as MDMA. Its slow onset can lead people to take more. It can cause dangerous overheating, high blood pressure, a racing heart, seizures and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: PMMA 已造成許多死亡，常是被當作 MDMA 販售時發生。它起效慢，可能讓人追加用量。它可能導致危險的體溫過高、高血壓、心跳過快、癲癇發作和血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: PMMA 已造成许多死亡，常是被当作 MDMA 贩售时发生。它起效慢，可能让人追加用量。它可能导致危险的体温过高、高血压、心跳过快、癫痫发作和血清素症候群。

fact.en: PMMA is to PMA what MDMA is to MDA: the same molecule with an extra methyl group on the nitrogen.
fact.zh: PMMA 和 PMA 的關係，就像 MDMA 和 MDA 的關係：同樣的分子，只是在氮原子上多了一個甲基。
fact.zhHans: PMMA 和 PMA 的关系，就像 MDMA 和 MDA 的关系：同样的分子，只是在氮原子上多了一个甲基。
